svg.title: The Vanilla Shop No04-Vanilla-Paste-100g jar wrap, 200 x 42 mm, 3 mm bleed

g.text: Grown in the hills of Kandy, Matale and Nuwara Eliya,
where every vanilla flower is pollinated by hand.
Made from the cured pods, seeds and all.
Level 26, East Tower, World Trade Center, Echelon Square, Colombo
